name: Barramundi (Siakap / Siakap Batu)
tactics: Target first 2 hours of Incoming Flood Tide around mangrove drains and jetty pilings. Use live prawns, live mullet, or 100mm minnow plugs.
rigging: 30lb Braid + 40lb Fluorocarbon Leader | #3/0 Live Bait Hook | Carolina Running Sinker Rig

name: Mangrove Red Snapper (Siakap Merah / Flamboyan)
tactics: Aggressive ambush predator in mangrove holes. Use 40lb fluorocarbon leader, live prawns, or weedless soft plastic lures.
rigging: 30lb Braid + 40lb Hard Leader | #2/0 Circle Hook | Weedless Jighead / Sinker Rig

name: Giant Trevally (Jemuduk / Ebek)
tactics: Hunts in heavy current rips at capes and oil rigs. Work 160mm topwater poppers aggressively during Solunar Major Overhead periods.
rigging: 65lb PE Braid + 80lb Fluorocarbon Leader (FG Knot) | #6/0 Popper Treble Hook | Heavy Topwater Rig

name: Spanish Mackerel (Tenggiri Batang)
tactics: Fast pelagic predator with razor teeth. Trolling minnows at 6 knots or wire-leader live baiting with live tamban (sardines).
rigging: 30lb Braid + #4 Single Strand Wire Leader | #3/0 Live Tamban Hook | Live Bait Trolling Rig

name: Golden Snapper (Jenahak)
tactics: Cautious deep channel bottom feeder. Target rocky bommies with live prawns or fresh squid tentacles on running sinker rigs.
rigging: 25lb Braid + 35lb Leader | #3/0 Chinu / Circle Hook | Running Sinker Apollo Rig

name: Fourfinger Threadfin (Kurau)
tactics: Stalks muddy tide lines near estuary beaches. Light tackle with live small prawns or silver micro-jigs.
rigging: 15lb Braid + 20lb Clear Leader | #1/0 Circle Hook | Light Surf Float Rig

name: Indian Threadfin (Senangin)
tactics: Shallow muddy bays and beach surf. Target with live glass shrimp or light bottom float rigs.
rigging: 12lb Braid + 15lb Leader | #1 Hook | Light Bottom Float Rig

name: Indo-Pacific Sailfish (Layaran)
tactics: World famous in Kuala Rompin! Live selar baiting on circle hooks under drift floats. High speed aerial jumps.
rigging: 30lb Mono + 50lb Wind-On Leader | #7/0 Non-Offset Circle Hook | Drift Balloon Rig

name: Coral Trout (Kerapu Sunoh / Kerapu Bintang)
tactics: Highly prized red coral grouper. Slow pitch jigging or bottom live baiting. Lock drag to prevent hole retreat.
rigging: 40lb PE Braid + 50lb Leader | #5/0 Live Bait Hook | Slow Pitch 100g Metal Jig Rig

name: Estuary Grouper (Kerapu Lumpur)
tactics: Muddy estuaries and harbor breakwaters. Heavy bottom baiting with live crab or mullet.
rigging: 30lb Braid + 40lb Leader | #4/0 Hook | Heavy Bottom Crab Rig

name: Cobia (Haruan Tasik)
tactics: Follows stingrays and turtles near buoys and oil platforms. Sight cast large soft plastics or live crabs.
rigging: 40lb Braid + 50lb Leader | #5/0 Live Crab Hook | Sight Cast Jighead Rig

name: Talang Queenfish (Talang)
tactics: High acrobatic leaps. Fast topwater pencil plugs or silver spoon trolling around capes.
rigging: 25lb Braid + 30lb Leader | #2/0 Treble Hook | Topwater Pencil Plug Rig

name: Yellowfin Tuna (Tongkol Kapor)
tactics: Deep oceanic drop-offs and seamounts. Heavy surface popping or live bait drifting.
rigging: 80lb PE Braid + 90lb Leader | #7/0 Circle Hook | Heavy Popper / Live Bait Drift Rig

name: Bigfin Reef Squid (Sotong Torak)
tactics: Night light squid fishing around piers and islands using size 2.5–3.5 Egi squid jigs.
rigging: 12lb Braid + 16lb Fluorocarbon Leader | Size 3.0 Egi Jig | Slow Driftegi Rig
